messages:
marie: Observed some double token billing for a customer on hosted API during streaming retry + toolcall. Root repro logs attached. Anyone else seen this?
raj: Saw something similar earlier today — looks like when the stream truncated and the client retried, the toolcall executed twice.
olivia: Can you paste the event ids and the small log snippet?
marie: event ids: ev=abc123 ev_retry=abc123-r1. Logs: ```2026-03-22T15:12:01Z stream EOF truncation; wrote toolcall invocation id=tc-9f; 2026-03-22T15:12:02Z reconnect retry -> toolcall invoked again id=tc-9f-dup```
sam: Which routing path caused the fallback? primary->modelA or did we swap to a quantized variant?
marie: routing: primary=us-west/modelA, fallback=us-east/modelA-8bit. Fallback triggers session reset and we reissue the toolcall because the route-change clears ephemeral session headers.
console-team: we've been getting customer reports about "duplicate charges" in the billing console. Do we think this is an actual double-bill or a provisional vs confirmed display quirk?
raj: Accounting is meant to mark the first toolcall provisional until confirmation from the session ledger. The retry path can create a second provisional/confirmed pair if the retry doesn't carry the same session id. Client dedupe is preferred but not reliable.
olivia: Quick telemetry: `select count(*) from token_events where session_id is null and event_type='toolcall' and is_retry = true and created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'` returns ~120 rows for the last day in prod.
marie: So two action areas: (1) server-side dedupe when client doesn't provide session id, and (2) console UX to surface provisional vs confirmed better for ops and customers.
sam: Server-side dedupe without session id is risky. One idea: short heuristic window (200-500ms) + same client ip + identical tool payload => treat as likely retry and suppress second provisional.
raj: Agree but risk of false positives on legitimate parallel requests. Maybe constrain heuristic to cases where stream EOF + immediate reconnect happened (i.e., graceful-mismatch pattern). That reduces false dedupe chance.
olivia: We should also tag telemetry when heuristic fires: `replay_heuristic_applied=true`, `dedupe_outcome= suppressed|allowed`. That way we can audit and rollback easily. Also generate trace ids for console linking.
console-team: For UX: add a visible "Provisional" badge on the charge line with hover text: "This charge is provisional pending session confirmation" and an action link "View trace" that opens the token_event trace for the user. Also add a filter for provisional-only charges for ops.
marie: Sounds good. I'll open an RFC that bundles server heuristic + telemetry tags + console UX changes. Who wants ownership of which piece?
raj: I'll own the server heuristic code, tests, and the canary rollout plan.
olivia: I'll own telemetry dashboards, the audit queries, and alerting for anomalous dedupe rates.
sam: I'll mock the console copy, implement the provisional badge + trace link, and wire it to the existing traceid field.
marie: Created ticket RW-5473: "retry-triggered duplicate toolcall billing — heuristic + observability + console UX" and added you all. Please add estimated ETA to the ticket.
deploy-bot: Deployment plan updated: heuristic canary scheduled for 2026-03-25 09:00 UTC (10% traffic), full rollout gated on metrics for 48h.
marie: Two quick constraints: ensure per-customer opt-out (some customers prefer no server dedupe), and we need an emergency kill switch in the control plane.
raj: Will include `customer_override_no_dedupe` check and global feature-flag `dedupe_retry_heuristic` with immediate rollout toggle.
olivia: I'll include dashboard panels that show suppressed_count / total_retry_count and an annotation when the feature flag flips.
marie: Ok. Final ask — make sure the telemetry preserves raw events so billing can replay if we mis-suppress. Add `replay_heuristic_applied` but keep original event stored.
raj: Will keep raw events immutable and only mark a derived suppression record. Tests will assert no raw loss.
marie: Thanks everyone — update RW-5473 as you start and add any follow-ups.
console-team: we'll prototype the UI copy in the trial account this week and share screenshots in the ticket.
marie: Closing the thread for now, but please ping if you spot regressions once canary runs.
